_note: Parameters for E1/E2/E3 (methods paper). Not run in the sandbox (needs the multiverse panel and 16 cores). Prepared 24 Nov 2026.

E0_prerequisite.check: ls $GM_DATA/meta.json and the series json files; confirm 20+ series incl. grouping variables. Gemini's runbook says /root/work/data and /root/work/groups/out/final400.pkl exist on the AutoDL box 'autodl2'; this was NOT verified here.
E0_prerequisite.if_missing: rebuild from research/records/2026-11-23-corr-rebuild/data/RAW_SOURCES.md and scripts/download_raw.sh, or ask the owner

E1_extend_draws.command: cd <scripts dir> && python3 determinism_check.py && GM_R=1200 GM_NPROC=16 GM_DATA=/root/work/data GM_OUT=out/final1200.pkl nohup python3 run_multiverse400.py > run1200.log 2>&1 &
notes: The runner has no start-at-r option; it recomputes r=0..R. Replicate r uses seed 1000+r so the first 400 must reproduce final400.pkl exactly: compare them (this is itself the determinism check). Do not merge pickles by hand unless the runner is first modified and re-tested.
Expected wall time about 3x the 400-draw run (~3 h on 16 cores for 1,200).

arithmetic.correction_to_runbook: the runbook's 'alpha_BY = 0.05/6.185 = 0.00808' is the BY level for the whole family, not the per-rank threshold; use the per-rank formula above

E1_extend_draws.report: for each of the 272 links the verdict at R = 74, 400, 800, 1200 under BH and BY; split-halves agreement at 1200 (two disjoint 600s); per-replicate wall times

E2_known_truth.code_in_repo_now: research/records/2026-11-24-assessment-and-next-experiments/scripts/known_truth_sim.py (simplified estimator). Run it as: python3 -I known_truth_sim.py 200 1200  (adds R=1200 column; ~1-2 h single core)
E2_known_truth.real_estimator_version: re-implement the regimes below on the real panel's country set, missingness and 50 groupings using gm_core; 200 replicates per regime; R in {74, 400, 1200}

regimes.A: uniform effect b=0.15 on the full series (truth: robust)
regimes.W: weak uniform b=0.06 (truth: robust, low power)
regimes.B: b=0.40 only in the top tercile of one grouping family (truth: group-specific)
regimes.D: null with shared country-specific trends (spurious levels link; the electricity case)
regimes.S: sign split +0.25/-0.25 by the median of a second family (truth: group-specific)
regimes.G_runbook: Gemini's variants: null; uniform beta=-0.05, AR(1) rho=0.85, sigma_eps=0.15; beta=-0.10 in Sub-Saharan Africa only. Add as extra regimes, do not replace A-S

E2_known_truth.report: type-I error per verdict (target <= 5%), power for A/B/S, share of regime-B replicates labelled robust everywhere, share of regime-D replicates labelled anything but none

E3_heterogeneity_condition.rule: robust-everywhere additionally requires: real heterogeneity rate (share of groupings whose group estimates are jointly heterogeneous at 5%, already computed) <= 95th percentile of the random-draw heterogeneity rate
E3_heterogeneity_condition.also: report group-specific tags for every link even when it is also robust
E3_heterogeneity_condition.decision: if >= 2 of the 5 links that 'travel' lose the label, rewrite paper Section 5.3
